description: Adds the plain-language rules to every session and subagent, and checks each chat reply and each prose file Claude writes.

hooks.command: command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || { printf '%s\n' '{"systemMessage":"plain-language: python3 was not found, so the plain-language hooks are off in this session. Install Python 3.9 or later, then start a new session."}'; exit 0; }; python3 -I "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/session-start.py" || exit 1
